# Adjustable Clamp Holder for Mannequin Heads and Practice Hands

Give your training a steady base with this black clamp holder for manicure practice hands and training mannequin heads. It suits cosmetology students, nail technicians, and anyone who wants a stable setup at the workbench.

## Sturdy Construction

The black plastic body is reinforced with metal, making it more durable than all-plastic clamps. Its adjustable length of 23 to 28 cm fits a range of desk edges.

## Adjustable Angles for Any Desk

A rotating ball lets you set the angle you prefer. The support surface adjusts about 30 degrees, so it can grip a table even when the surface is slightly inclined.

## Quick Setup, Easy to Carry

At roughly 280 g and 5.5 cm wide, the holder is compact enough to pack into a training kit. It assembles and removes without tools, so you can move between class and home practice with little effort.

## Hands-Free Practice

It holds standard-size training mannequin heads and manicure practice hands, leaving both of your hands free to focus on technique.
